name: Private food runtime configuration declaration and activation runbook
objective: Record future dedicated food infrastructure contracts and separately authorized operational phases without changing active configuration or activating infrastructure or product access.

requirements: Use a dedicated food database; never reuse commerce, CRM, insurance, Sesh or identity databases.
The eventual Wrangler declaration contains binding RIVER_FOOD_DB, selected dedicated database_name, verified assigned database_id and migrations_dir migrations/food.
Do not place placeholder IDs into active configuration. Preserve all unrelated database declarations and migration-directory conventions.

administratorContract.recommendation: Use an environment-specific Wrangler secret/environment-secret mechanism for the concrete production value rather than committing it to Git.
requirements: PrincipalId is privileged configuration, not an authentication credential; secrecy never replaces session/principal authorization.

A separately authorized identity-verification step must use the existing authenticated principal/session system, resolve the intended administrator through canonical identity records, verify the principal is active in the intended environment and capture the exact canonical PrincipalId.
Never derive identity from display name, email/name guesses, River OS access keys, Sesh identities, test fixtures, food IDs or login success alone.

futurePhases.name: Target selection
futurePhases.work: Choose account/environment/database name/location, dedicated local/dev isolation and recovery/backup policy.

futurePhases.name: Database provisioning
futurePhases.work: Create dedicated food D1 database, capture and verify assigned ID; no migration yet.

futurePhases.name: Repository configuration declaration
futurePhases.work: Add verified binding and migration directory, regenerate Cloudflare typing using normal Wrangler workflow, validate configuration before deployment.

futurePhases.name: Migration application
futurePhases.authorization: Explicit separate authorization required; remote execution requires user approval immediately before execution
futurePhases.work: Inspect target and migration inventory, apply the existing food migration only to the approved target, then verify tables, foreign keys, immutable UPDATE/DELETE triggers and migration state.

futurePhases.name: Administrator identity verification/configuration
futurePhases.work: Verify intended active canonical principal and configure the administrator key for that exact environment.

futurePhases.name: Private route/UI activation
futurePhases.authorization: Explicit separate design and approval required
futurePhases.work: Design and approve the first River OS private food route/UI; infrastructure activation never implies route activation.

operationalGates: No phase silently authorizes the next; FOOD-001H authorizes none of these operational phases.

Future local/dev verification requires separate nonproduction configuration, dedicated local persistence/state directory, synthetic/nonproduction identities where practical and explicit local target verification before migration.
Never let default project configuration accidentally point tests/dev work at remote production resources.

Before remote migration verify Cloudflare account, exact configuration/environment, binding/name/ID, migration inventory and backup/recovery plan; obtain explicit user approval immediately before execution.
Future command examples are manual approval steps only and contain no real IDs or secrets.
Regenerate generated Cloudflare typing only after separately approved actual binding declaration; FOOD-001F/G structural typing remains valid until then.
recovery: Database changes are durable outside Git; reverting code/config does not undo an applied migration.
Append-only triggers intentionally restrict ordinary repair. Prefer forward corrective migrations and disabling access over destructive rollback.
Establish recovery policy before remote activation. Destructive rollback is outside FOOD-001H.
Production consistency/transport verification remains separate from FOOD-001C's isolated local Miniflare evidence.
excludedAndDeferredScope: No FOOD-001A-G source changes or unrelated insurance/Sesh/creator changes.
No wrangler.jsonc edits, active binding changes, placeholder active database IDs or worker-configuration.d.ts modification/regeneration.
No database provisioning, migration execution, administrator lookup, secret creation or runtime access configuration.
No routes/actions/UI, public food products, checkout/Stripe/commerce, fulfillment/accounting/community/public counters.
No deployment, production activation, configured local/remote D1 access or production data.
validation: Check Markdown structure and repository links.
Check sanitization: no concrete secrets, database IDs or principal values recorded.
Run git diff --check and whitespace checks for new files.
currentTaskBoundary: Create only the specification and architecture runbook; stop before staging, commit or push.
